verdict.rationale: Airbyte offers a Terraform provider to version-control connection/config as code (airbyte-docs-2/19), a public API for programmatic/orchestrated control (airbyte-docs-3/18/46), and PyAirbyte for defining extraction pipelines as Python code (airbyte-docs-1/47) — all supporting a code-first, repo-based workflow. However, the core product experience (Connector Builder, connection setup, scheduling) is UI-driven and no-code by design (airbyte-docs-4/20/43), and there is no evidence of a single declarative manifest/CLI-native workflow that fully replaces the UI for day-to-day pipeline definition, nor independent hands-on confirmation that Terraform-managed configs round-trip cleanly with the UI. missing for 10: native CLI/declarative-file-first pipeline authoring without UI dependency, independent verification of Terraform/API config fidelity, and evidence of code review workflows integrated with Airbyte configs.
